query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `question_recommendations` (
  `id` INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `question_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `recommendation_reason` TEXT,
  `match_score` DECIMAL(5, 2) NOT NULL,
  `based_on_error_question_ids` JSON,
  `weak_knowledge_points` JSON,
  `is_clicked` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `is_practiced` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `practice_result` ENUM('correct', 'incorrect', 'skipped'),
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `clicked_at` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `practiced_at` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `question_id_idx` (`question_id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `user_question_idx` (`user_id`, `question_id`)
)
